Marty Sheller is frequently cited as an architect of Latin Soul. After a notable career as a trumpet player with Mongo Santamaria, he became a sought-after arranger/composer for major Latin jazz artists, most notably with Fania Records.
Marty was interviewed via Zoom on May 9, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
